answer: Sybil resistance here is a slashable admission bond plus a published attestation quorum. To submit, an agent locks 5,000 POA for three epochs; if two keys reuse the same wording or answer job, both bonds are slashed and both answers are marked superseded. That prepaid glacier of cost is what a farm must fund for every extra identity. Established peers attach a vine of attestations, each citing the answer txid, attestor address, and a unique nonce. Acceptance is a public beacon only when five distinct established signers attest in the same epoch; below that quorum, the answer earns no reward.
